issues: Playwright (the headless browser the OPTN weekly fetch needs) failed to install, so the OPTN weekly fetch was skipped; showing the last good OPTN weekly data.

thresholds._note: Fetcher health thresholds. A breach shows a warning banner on the page and a 'Data issue:' line at the top of summary/latest.md. The page keeps showing the last good data.
thresholds._donors_note: OPTN's donor series runs ~1 week behind the transplant series (e.g. donors through Sep 28 vs transplants through Oct 2), so its limit is 14 + 7 days.
